description: Move the active claim deadline using the worker token and current receipt. Visibility accepts 30-900 seconds, defaults to 60 seconds and is capped by the original queue expiry. A stale or expired receipt is a conflict. Queue lifetime is never extended.

job_id.description: The job_id of the claimed job.

queue_id.description: The queue_id from create_agent_queue, or from create_agent_run for a run with delegated steps.

receipt.description: The receipt from the current claim. A newer claim or a release makes it stale.

visibility_timeout.description: Claim visibility in seconds, capped by the fixed queue expiry.

worker_token.description: The worker_token from create_agent_queue or create_agent_run, shown once. It claims jobs and acknowledges, renews or releases them.

name: renew_agent_queue_job
title: Renew agent queue job
